prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Game prices, and price-drop alerts for whoever follows a game. Without a key it uses CheapShark; with a free IsThereAnyDeal key you get dozens of shops in your country’s currency.
prices.countryHint: Decides the shops and the currency ({{currency}}).
prices.countryCheapShark: CheapShark always shows PC shops in US dollars. The country counts once you add the IsThereAnyDeal key.
prices.everyHint: Includes everyone’s “To play” lists. Alerts go out with this check.
prices.keyKept: Saved (ends in {{hint}}) — leave blank to keep it
prices.keyRemoved: Key removed: prices now come from CheapShark.

testFail.unreadable: The saved key can no longer be read. Enter the key again.

prices.unreadable: The saved key can no longer be read (TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY changed). Until you enter it again, prices come from CheapShark.
prices.keyHelp: Register a free app at IsThereAnyDeal and copy its “API key”.
